permits.why_needed: Required to define scope, methodology, and study areas for the Environmental Impact Assessment before conducting the EIA study for the SAF biomass FT facility
required_inputs: baseline data on air, water, soil, ecology
permits.evidence_required: Terms of Reference letter from MoEFCC/SEIAA

permits.why_needed: Mandatory statutory clearance under EIA Notification for construction and operation of the SAF biomass FT facility; covers air, water, land, ecological impacts
permits.evidence_required: Environmental Clearance letter from MoEFCC/SEIAA

permits.why_needed: Required as part of the EIA process to gather and address concerns of local communities and stakeholders affected by the SAF facility construction
required_inputs: EIA summary report (executive summary in local language)
permits.evidence_required: Public hearing proceedings report duly signed by the presiding officer

permits.permit_name: Consent for Establishment (CFE) / Air Emissions Consent
permits.why_needed: Required under the Air (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act before construction begins; covers emissions from gasifiers, turbines, boilers, heaters, and flaring
required_inputs: air emission inventory and source list
pollution control equipment details (ESP, scrubbers, bag filters)
permits.evidence_required: Consent for Establishment (CFE) letter from State Pollution Control Board (SPCB)

permits.why_needed: Required by Central Ground Water Authority for withdrawing groundwater for cooling, process water, and utility needs of the SAF facility; critical in water-stressed regions
permits.evidence_required: Groundwater Abstraction / NOC letter from CGWA

permits.why_needed: Required if the facility draws water from rivers, canals, or reservoirs for process or cooling needs; governed by state irrigation/water resources departments
permits.evidence_required: Surface Water Abstraction License from state Irrigation/Water Resources Department

permits.permit_name: Consent to Establish / Water (Effluent) Discharge Consent
permits.why_needed: Required under the Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act for discharge of treated effluent from the SAF facility; covers wastewater from FT synthesis, cooling tower blowdown, and utilities
permits.evidence_required: Consent for Establishment (Water) letter from SPCB

permits.why_needed: Required under Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management & Transboundary Movement) Rules for generation, storage, treatment, and disposal of hazardous wastes including ash, char, spent catalyst, spent guard bed, and spent caustic from the SAF facility
required_inputs: hazardous waste inventory and characterization (ash, char, spent catalyst, spent guard bed, spent caustic)
storage area design and containment details
permits.evidence_required: Hazardous Waste Authorisation letter from SPCB

permits.why_needed: Required under the Static & Mobile Pressure Vessels (SMPV) Rules and Petroleum Rules for manufacturing, storage, and handling of hazardous chemicals including syngas, H2, CO, and FT fuels (naphtha, SAF, diesel) at the SAF facility
required_inputs: list of hazardous chemicals with quantities (syngas, H2, CO, SAF, naphtha, diesel, wax)
process flow diagram and storage layout
safety data sheets (SDS) for all hazardous chemicals
permits.evidence_required: PESO licence (Form XIV / SMPV licence) from Chief Controller of Explosives

permits.permit_name: Pressure Vessels and Boilers Licence (Factory Inspectorate)
permits.why_needed: Required under the Boilers Act and Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR) / local regulations for design, fabrication, installation, and operation of pressure vessels, boilers, waste heat recovery units, and syngas coolers at the SAF facility
required_inputs: pressure vessel and boiler design drawings (IBR / ASME certified)
material test certificates and welding procedures
permits.evidence_required: Boiler / Pressure Vessel registration certificate from Chief Inspector of Boilers / Factory Inspectorate

permits.permit_name: Fire NOC (No Objection Certificate) from Fire Department
permits.why_needed: Required for building plan approval and facility operation to ensure compliance with fire safety standards for the SAF facility handling flammable gases, liquids, and biomass feedstocks
required_inputs: fire protection system design (hydrants, sprinklers, detectors, foam system)
building plan with fire escape routes
fire water tank and pump capacity calculations
permits.evidence_required: Fire NOC letter from local Fire Department / Chief Fire Officer

permits.permit_name: Storage Tank Licence (Naphtha, SAF, Diesel, Wax)
permits.why_needed: Required under Petroleum Rules and SMPV Rules for installation and operation of above-ground storage tanks (fixed roof, floating roof) for liquid fuels including naphtha, SAF, diesel, and wax intermediates at the FT facility
required_inputs: tank design and construction specifications (API 650 / API 620)
tank farm layout with spacing calculations
permits.evidence_required: Storage Tank Licence from PESO / Chief Controller of Explosives

permits.why_needed: Required under the Explosives Rules for storage of oxygen cylinders and high-pressure gas storage vessels (e.g., H2 and CO at >100 bar) used in the FT synthesis and gasification sections
required_inputs: high-pressure storage vessel specifications and test certificates
storage area layout with safety distances
permits.evidence_required: Explosives Licence from PESO / Chief Controller of Explosives

permits.permit_name: Aviation Fuel Handling Interface / Airport Fuel Permit
permits.why_needed: Required for supplying SAF (Sustainable Aviation Fuel) to airports; covers fuel quality specifications, offloading, storage, blending, and custody transfer at airport fuel hydrant systems
required_inputs: SAF quality certificates (ASTM D7566 / D1655 compliance)
fuel quality monitoring and testing protocol
permits.evidence_required: Airport Fuel Handling Permit / Fuel Suppliers Licence from airport authority

permits.why_needed: Required to confirm that the selected site is zoned for industrial / chemical / heavy manufacturing use and complies with local municipal or district land-use plans for the SAF facility
required_inputs: zoning map and land-use classification certificate
permits.evidence_required: Zoning clearance / Land Use Certificate from local municipal authority / district planning department

permits.why_needed: Required for approval of all structural building plans, layouts, and elevations of the SAF facility from the local municipal corporation or development authority before construction
required_inputs: parking, green area, and drainage plans
permits.evidence_required: Building Plan Approval letter / Commencement Certificate from municipal authority

permits.why_needed: Required to legally commence construction activities at the SAF facility site; covers site preparation, civil works, foundations, and structural erection
permits.evidence_required: Construction Permit / Work Order from municipal authority or relevant permitting body

permits.why_needed: Required under the Factories Act for registration and operation of the SAF manufacturing facility; covers worker safety, working conditions, hazardous process notifications, and compliance with occupational health standards
required_inputs: factory plan and layout with hazardous area classification
list of manufacturing processes and equipment
hazard identification and risk assessment (HIRA) report
permits.evidence_required: Factory Registration Certificate / Factory Licence from Director of Industrial Safety / Chief Inspector of Factories

permits.why_needed: Required under the Electricity Act and state electricity rules for approval of electrical installations, high-tension connections, switchyards, substations, and hazardous area electrical equipment at the SAF facility
permits.evidence_required: Electrical Safety Approval / Chief Electrical Inspector certificate from state electrical inspectorate

permits.why_needed: Required under Air and Water Acts before commencing commercial production; certifies that pollution control systems are installed and operational as per the approved design
required_inputs: commissioning reports of pollution control equipment
stack monitoring and effluent analysis results
permits.evidence_required: Consent to Operate (CTO) letter from State Pollution Control Board (SPCB)

permits.why_needed: Required under ICAO's Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation to certify that the SAF produced meets CORSIA sustainability criteria and is eligible for emissions reduction credits
permits.evidence_required: CORSIA eligible fuel certificate from approved sustainability certification body

permits.why_needed: Required to certify that the biomass feedstock, production process, and entire supply chain for SAF meet International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC) or Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB) standards for market access
permits.evidence_required: ISCC / RSB Certificate (EU RED or CORSIA compliant)

permits.why_needed: Required to register the SAF facility's GHG emission reductions under a carbon credit standard (e.g., VCS/Verra, Gold Standard, CORSIA) to generate tradeable carbon credits from biomass feedstock carbon savings
dependencies: production data available for baseline period
permits.evidence_required: Carbon credit registration letter from Verra / Gold Standard / relevant registry

permits.why_needed: Required under the Public Liability Insurance Act for industries handling hazardous substances; provides immediate relief to victims of accidents involving hazardous chemicals at the SAF facility
permits.evidence_required: Public Liability Insurance policy certificate from approved insurer

permits.why_needed: Required to cover remediation costs from potential environmental damage (soil contamination, groundwater pollution, ecological damage) from leaks, spills, or accidents at the SAF biomass FT facility
permits.evidence_required: Environmental Impairment Liability (EIL) insurance policy certificate

permits.permit_name: Health and Safety Case / Major Hazard Facility (MHFA) Approval
permits.why_needed: Required under the Manufacture, Storage and Import of Hazardous Chemicals (MSIHC) Rules for facilities exceeding threshold quantities of hazardous chemicals; requires submission of a detailed safety case covering risk assessment, consequence modelling, and emergency planning
required_inputs: major accident hazard (MAH) identification and risk assessment
consequence modelling report (dispersion, overpressure, thermal radiation)
permits.evidence_required: Major Hazard Facility (MHF) approval letter from the competent authority (MoEFCC / Factory Inspectorate)

permits.permit_name: High-Pressure Gas Transmission / Piping Approval (H2, CO, Syngas)
permits.why_needed: Required under SMPV Rules / Gas Cylinder Rules for design, fabrication, testing, and operation of high-pressure interconnecting piping conveying H2, CO, and syngas at elevated pressures throughout the FT facility
required_inputs: piping stress analysis and flexible connection design
pipeline material certificates and welding qualifications (ASME B31.3)
permits.evidence_required: High-pressure gas piping approval from PESO / Factory Inspectorate

permits.permit_name: Wastewater Treatment / ZLD (Zero Liquid Discharge) Approval
permits.why_needed: Required to ensure that the SAF facility's wastewater treatment system achieves zero liquid discharge standards; covers design, performance, and discharge compliance for treated water reuse within the facility
required_inputs: ZLD system design (RO, MEE, crystallizer, evaporator)
treated water quality analysis and reuse plan
permits.evidence_required: ZLD approval / NOC from State Pollution Control Board (SPCB)

permits.why_needed: Required under Solid Waste Management Rules for management of non-hazardous solid waste including biomass ash, char fines, spent guard bed material, spent catalyst, and waste oils generated from the FT and gasification processes
required_inputs: solid waste characterization and quantification report
waste segregation, storage, and disposal plan
permits.evidence_required: Solid Waste Management Plan approval letter from SPCB / local municipal authority

permits.permit_name: Noise Pollution / Ambient Noise Level Consent
permits.why_needed: Required under the Noise Pollution (Regulation & Control) Rules to ensure noise levels from compressors, turbines, gasifiers, coolers, and flares at the SAF facility comply with prescribed limits for industrial zones
required_inputs: noise source inventory (compressors, turbines, flaring, fans)
noise attenuation measures design (enclosures, silencers, barriers)
permits.evidence_required: Noise level compliance certificate / NOC from SPCB

permits.why_needed: Required for storage, handling, and processing of large quantities of biomass feedstock; may require phytosanitary certification, biodiversity impact assessment, and customs clearance for imported biomass
required_inputs: biodiversity impact assessment (if sourcing from ecologically sensitive areas)
storage yard design with dust and leachate control
permits.evidence_required: Feedstock storage permit / phytosanitary clearance from agriculture / forestry department
